description: Run before buying, accepting or recommending a token. Answers SAFE, CAUTION or AVOID with exact reasons from chain and market data. Simulates a real holder selling, then checks if liquidity can be pulled, the creator's record, insider wallet networks, issuer powers (mint, freeze, Token-2022 traps), verification, liquidity, holders and age, for one verdict. Example: {"token": "DezXAZ8z7PnrnRJjz3wXBoRgixCa6xjnB7YaB1pPB263"} checks BONK. Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.02 USDC per call (x402). Outputs explained: GET /api/tools/token_safety.

network.description: Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). "devnet" only for test wallets.

token.description: The token's address. From find_token (for a ticker) or tokens (for a wallet's tokens).

name: token_safety
